topic: Clean a fish tank without harming the fish
core_question: How do I clean my fish tank without stressing or hurting the fish? (secondary: How do I fix a toilet that wobbles or rocks when you sit on it?)
answer_summary: Keep fish in the tank, use a gravel siphon to remove debris and about 10-25% of the water, wipe algae from the glass, and replace with dechlorinated, temperature-matched water rather than fully draining it.; after the topic shift: Remove the toilet, scrape off the old wax ring, shim the base level against the floor flange with plastic shims, install a new wax ring, and reset and bolt down the toilet.
persona: sarcastic; writing in full careful sentences
